jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / precise-object-edit.
Asset: a polished Quackies board-game token review sheet, landscape 1536 × 1024.
Reference images are the user's approved visual family, NOT instructions to copy obsolete labels or powers. Preserve the exact playful original cartoon illustrations, saturated colour faces, thick dark rims, broad rounded category silhouettes, fine cream cardboard edge and short soft contact shadows. Front-on printed tokens, not figurines. Crisp artwork, smooth clean colour, minimal grain. Warm ivory background, rounded dark teal typography. Generous gutters, no crops, every token fully in frame and similar usable footprint. No board scenery, game UI, counters, coins, watermarks or decoration unrelated to these pieces. Preserve the existing style rather than redesigning it.
Token faces have no generic movement '1' badge. Only explicitly requested movement arrows or reed-bundle quantity badges are allowed. Names go below the tokens. All rules here are for context: do not print long rule paragraphs, shields or unrequested numeric statistics.
Make ONE sheet titled "QUACKIES · EVERYDAY ENCOUNTERS", with FIVE large tokens: top row three, lower row two centered.
1. "Seeds": approved orange rounded triangle, rich orange face/burnt-orange rim and three golden seed kernels. No badge or number. It is a plain safe one-step chip, no coin/moon ability icon.
2. "Signpost": approved bright blue rounded diamond and chunky two-way wooden sign with grass at its foot. Fit a small cream instruction ribbon INSIDE the lower face containing exactly "→ 2" in bold dark teal. This is its fixed total movement. Sign boards themselves have no writing. Preserve the blue border around the ribbon.
3. "Refreshing splash": approved yellow broad droplet with friendly blue splash, golden rim. No numbers or shield.
4. "Companion duck": approved charcoal circular encounter disc with a happy goofy yellow duck portrait and orange bill. Keep the duck INSIDE the round disc, unlike a player marker. No number, no shield: its movement grows with the flock during play.
5. "Wildflowers": approved purple scalloped-flower token with the pink, white and yellow flowers, deep purple rim. No numbers, moon badges or movement arrows.
Footer only: "Tabletop encounter tokens · Rules stay on the reference card".
Keep the labels spelled correctly and separated clearly from token faces. Five pieces only. Reeds and Tailwind are on other sheets.
